name: WE-053 Corvany personal data residency (loop seed)

unclear.text: Section 4(2): a copy made solely for security may be kept outside Corvany where the Office so allows by regulation; the Office has issued no regulation.
readings: U1-a: encrypted backup copies may be kept abroad (the regulation sets only conditions)
U1-b: until the Office allows it by regulation, every copy, including backups, must be in Corvany

a1.text: The requirement binds: many covered controllers would host abroad without it.

a2.text: The Office enforces the requirement against controllers with an establishment in Corvany.

a10.text: The cost of compliance is material against the gain from growing past 50,000.

a18.text: For some small facilities, the certificate and audit cost more than the margin on hosting covered data.

a22.text: The supplementary appropriation is paid from the general budget, with no named tax.

a27.text: Actors expect the requirement to apply from 1 January 2029, as enacted.
